A.

ZONE CHANGE NO. 330 - PUBLIC HEARING TO CONSIDER A REQUEST TO CHANGE THE ZONE DESIGNATION FROM R-1 TO R-2 FOR THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 212 N. 2ND STREET
It is recommended that the City Council 1) Open the public hearing; 2) Take public testimony; 3) Read the ordinance by title and waive further reading; 4) Introduce the Ordinance approving Zone Change 330 for subsequent adoption.

CC.B-1 Zone Change 330 - CC Ordinance

It is recommended that the City Council 1) Open the public hearing; 2) Take public testimony; 3) Read the ordinance by title and waive further reading; 4) Introduce the Ordinance approving Zone Change 330 for subsequent adoption.
CC.B-2 Zone Change 331 - CC Staff Report
CC.B-2 Zone Change 331 - Ordinance

It is recommended that the City Council 1) Open the public hearing and take public testimony; 2) Close the public hearing; 3) Adopt the Draft Resolution certifying that the City is in compliance with the 2010 Congestion Management Program, adopting the 2011 CMP Local Implementation Report and directing the City Clerk to forward a certified copy of said Resolution to Los Angeles County Metro.

RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION
REPORT OUT OF CLOSED SESSION

It is recommended that the City Council adopt the attached Resolution adopting a Performance Improvement Agreement with the California Joint Powers Insurance Authority
CC.C-2 Cal JPIA Performance Improvment Plan Staff Report
CC.C-2 Resolution adopting Performance Improvement Agreement with JPIA
CC.C-2 gLa Puente PIP Matrix with progress comments updated

It is recommended that the City Council 1) approve and adopt the attached Resolution amending the FY 2011/2012 Adopted Budget to lower by $149,900 for a total budget of $4,777,250 and 2) authorize the City Manager to sign the Contract City Law Enforcement Services for FY 2011/2012.
CC.C-3 FY 11-12 Contract City Law Enforcement Services

It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Resolution approving Warrant Register No. 1303.
CC.D-1 Resoultion Warrant Register #1303

It is recommended that the City Council: 1) award the contract to Koam Construction, Inc. in the amount of $887,400.00 and 2) authorize the City Manager to approve change orders up to 10 % of the bid amount.

CC.D-3 MOU with SEIU

It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution and approve the Letter of Agreement.

CC.D-4 Letter of Agreement
